correctness.rationale: The defined finite graph and all 8,192 induced-subgraph subsets are independently enumerated at cutoffs 1,2,3; torus links and the signed fundamental cycle and filling are checked exactly. An acyclic 154-pair Morse matching is verified on all 897 incidences and has integral differential (0,0), giving S2 wedge two S3. Every one of 182 elementary relative collapses is independently checked. Obstruction theory for a simply connected target identifies the zero H2 map of the oriented torus as a nullhomotopic inclusion. Pure three-dimensional facets and nonzero H2 imply nonshellability. Independent mod-two/three/five homology corroborates the results but is not used as an integral proof.

value.rationale: The first higher-independence stages of the natural 13-vertex Paley conference graph display a non-obvious nullhomotopic torus inclusion despite both stages having integral rank-one H2; therefore their individual Betti numbers fail to capture the persistence map. The following stage is actually simple-homotopy equivalent, a sharp structural plateau. An exact signed 26-tetrahedron filling and 182 literal free-face collapses make a motivated self-contained finite topology result, beyond routine face counting or known-table recomputation.
